w: The Wilder Kaiser's highest point at 2,344m, marked by a summit cross erected in 1883. Just below it stands the tiny, unheated Babenstuber Hut, an emergency shelter in place since 1891. The usual route up, the Gamsangersteig, carries a real rockfall risk - climbers are told to bring a helmet.
_facts: highest peak in the Wilder Kaiser massif at 2,344m
Babenstuber emergency hut in place since 1891, not weatherproof
normal route (Gamsangersteig) has high rockfall risk

w: A multi-summited peak in the otherwise gentle, grass-covered Kitzbühel Alps, its main top reaching 2,362m. What sets it apart is a 400-metre-high, craggy limestone summit block on a base of grauwacke and quartz phyllite. Isolated from its neighbours, it draws hikers as the range's most visually striking mountain.
s: A 400m limestone block on gentle grass peaks
_facts: main summit 2,362m, dominating peak of the Spertental valley
400m-high craggy limestone summit block over a grauwacke and quartz phyllite base
not the Kitzbühel Alps' highest (that's the Kreuzjoch, 2,558m) but its most striking

w: At 1,996m, this mountain above Kitzbühel's western flank misses two-thousander status by four metres, yet carries a 102m ORF transmission tower on its summit that makes it unmistakable for miles. The Harschbichl, a subsidiary top at 1,604m to the north, is also reachable.
s: A TV tower four metres short of 2,000m
_facts: 102m ORF transmission tower at the summit
subsidiary peak Harschbichl (1,604m) to the north

w: Straddling the Tyrol-Salzburg border above the Bürgl Hut, this 2,366m peak carries a local legend: gold was said to have been mined here by Venetian prospectors, the 'Venediger' of Alpine folklore. Festivals on the nearby Schlaberstatt crossing supposedly drew even the Devil among the musicians.
s: The peak where the Devil joined the band
_facts: 2,366m, straddling the Tyrol-Salzburg border about 7km southeast of Jochberg
legend of Venetian ('Venediger') gold prospectors on the mountain
folk tradition of festivals at the Schlaberstatt crossing featuring the Devil among the musicians
